name: Quel'Lithien Lodge
summary: Quel'Lithien Lodge is an isolated high elven hunting lodge nestled in the forested northern hills of the Eastern Plaguelands near the entrance to Quel'Thalas. Its Farstrider rangers hold out among the blighted woods, surrounded by the Scourge and hunted by Forsaken agents, while guarding old elven archives.

sections.title: A Ranger Camp in the Blight
sections.body: Before the Third War, Quel'Lithien was a commonly visited Farstrider camp on the road toward Quel'Thalas, and it housed a number of elven documents, including records of the rangers and the royal family. The lodge fell on hard times after the Scourge swept through Lordaeron and into the elven kingdom. Today its rangers keep their vigil in the corrupted forest, one of only two major concentrations of high elves left in Lordaeron.

sections.title: Hunted in the Plaguelands
sections.body: The rangers' quiet vigil has not gone unnoticed. Deep within the tainted woods, Nathanos Blightcaller—once the solitary human Ranger Lord trained alongside these very elves—has directed Horde champions to infiltrate Quel'Lithien Lodge. Nathanos seeks the Quel'Thalas Registry, an official record containing details of the ranger order and elven lineages, ordering the slaughter of the lodge's defenders to retrieve it. The rangers at Quel'Lithien find themselves besieged by former allies and the surrounding undead alike.

faq.q: Why are there living high elves in the Eastern Plaguelands?
faq.answer: The lodge has long been a Farstrider camp. Its high elven rangers remain here even after the Scourge laid waste to the region, holding one of the last elven footholds in Lordaeron near the road to Quel'Thalas.

faq.q: Are the elves at Quel'Lithien Lodge part of the Alliance?
faq.answer: No. While they are friendly to Alliance travelers and openly hostile toward the Horde, the lodge functions as an entirely autonomous high elven settlement receiving no formal support or direction from Stormwind or Ironforge.

faq.q: Why does Nathanos Blightcaller target the lodge?
faq.answer: Nathanos Blightcaller sends Horde agents to attack the lodge specifically to secure the Quel'Thalas Registry, an important historical document chronicling elven ranger personnel and records that remains stored in the lodge's archives.

faq.q: How does Quel'Lithien differ from Quel'Danil Lodge?
faq.answer: Both were historic high elven hunting lodges, but Quel'Danil is situated safely among friendly Wildhammer dwarves in the Hinterlands. Quel'Lithien sits isolated on the frontline of the Eastern Plaguelands, trapped between the blighted ruins and the closed gates of Quel'Thalas.

angles.text: The Farstriders stationed here represent centuries of classical Thalassian marksmanship, maintaining their survival skills in a hostile wilderness completely cut off from civil society.
Operating on orders from Nathanos Blightcaller out of the Marris Stead, Horde champions are dispatched here on a deadly mission to seize high elven records through sheer force.
